description: This file defines a service for aggregating Large Language Model (LLM) costs by agent. It includes functions to build MongoDB aggregation pipelines for various schema types, an in-memory fallback aggregator, and an exported async function that attempts to retrieve aggregated costs from the database with fallback handling.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for flat schema documents containing agent identifiers and cost information, supporting nested cost objects and various field name variants.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Builds an aggregation pipeline for documents with 'Agents' array, each element containing 'Agent Name' and 'Total Cost'; used for array-based schemas.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: In-memory aggregation of agent costs from an array of documents, summing 'Total Cost' for each agent, normalizing names, and returning sorted results with 6-decimal precision.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main exported async function that queries multiple collections, attempting schema-specific aggregation pipelines; if database aggregation fails, it falls back to in-memory aggregation. Returns an array of agents with total costs.
